summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.82. The account k.erdem@aegean.edu shows two concurrent access patterns: (1) legitimate on-campus logins from 193.140.10.9 (AS-AEGEAN-EDU, Manisa, TR) via device dev-ke-ws during business hours across portal/mail/vpn, and (2) repeated successful logins from 203.0.113.45 (AS14061 DigitalOcean, Frankfurt, DE) via the portal app every ~2 days at ~02:00–02:04 AM with an empty device_id and 0 MFA prompts. The foreign-cloud logins occur over weeks, use no university VPN appliance (via_vpn_appliance empty), present no enrolled device, and bypass MFA despite an unrecognized location/IP — classic persistent unauthorized access while the legitimate user continues normal use. Signals are repeated and unexplained (not weak, not explained by VPN/known travel), sufficient to treat as confirmed account takeover rather than exposure needing human triage.
